description: This source file defines a script that generates content for a roadmap tree by calling OpenAI's API. It imports necessary modules, defines data structures for nodes, and processes each node to produce descriptive content, writing it to markdown files. The script manages API calls, file I/O, and concurrency control.

methods.name: generateContent
methods.description: Calls OpenAI API to generate descriptive content for a given node based on a prompt.

methods.name: processNode
methods.description: Processes a single node by generating content and writing it to a corresponding markdown file.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that processes all nodes in batches, managing API calls and file writing.
